guide_extractions.document_match_reason: The guide was released Sept. 21, 2026 for USC's Sept. 26 Game 5 against Oregon. Its cover, matchup notes, scouting report and series history focus on Oregon. Washington is listed as USC's following opponent on Oct. 3.

recent_game.fact: USC improved to 4-0 overall and 1-0 in Big Ten play with a 42-35 road victory over Rutgers on Sept. 19.
USC never trailed against Rutgers and produced 461 total yards at 7.3 yards per play, including 5.9 yards per rush and 8.7 yards per pass attempt.
USC scored four offensive touchdowns, one defensive touchdown and two field goals against Rutgers.
USC converted 5 of 10 third downs against Rutgers, including 2 of 3 in the fourth quarter.
USC intercepted two Rutgers passes, returned them for 115 yards and scored 14 points off Rutgers' two turnovers.

opponent_notes.fact: Washington was 3-0 entering its Sept. 26 game against Minnesota after defeating Eastern Washington 48-16.
USC is scheduled to host Washington at 4:30 p.m. PT on Oct. 3.

quarterback.fact: Starting quarterback Jayden Maiava completed 20 of 32 passes for 277 yards, two touchdowns and no interceptions against Rutgers.
Maiava completed passes to nine Trojans against Rutgers and went 5 of 6 for 35 yards and a touchdown in the fourth quarter.
Through four games, Maiava had completed 87 of 115 passes for 1,173 yards, 12 touchdowns and one interception, with a 75.7% completion rate and 194.0 efficiency rating.
Maiava entered 2026 after starting all 13 games for USC in 2025, when he passed for 3,711 yards and 24 touchdowns with 10 interceptions.
USC quarterback Sam Huard previously attended Washington, Cal Poly and Utah.

offensive_personnel.fact: Kayden Dixon-Wyatt led USC against Rutgers with five receptions for 77 yards and caught a two-point conversion.
Through four games, Dixon-Wyatt led USC with 18 receptions and 258 receiving yards and had two touchdown catches.
Corey Simms caught all four of his targets for a career-high 72 yards and his first collegiate touchdown against Rutgers, including a 52-yard score on third-and-14.
King Miller rushed 16 times for 102 yards and a touchdown against Rutgers, his second consecutive 100-yard rushing game.
Through four games, Miller led USC with 338 rushing yards and three touchdowns on 64 carries.
Riley Wormley produced 54 yards from scrimmage and two touchdowns on four touches against Rutgers, including three carries for 52 yards and a two-yard touchdown reception.
Freshman tight end Mark Bowman caught three passes for 32 yards against Rutgers after recording six catches for 83 yards and two touchdowns against Louisiana.
Five true freshmen started USC's season opener: wide receivers Kayden Dixon-Wyatt, Trent Mosley and Tron Baker, tight end Mark Bowman and defensive end Luke Wafle.

USC's offensive line allowed one sack against Rutgers while helping the Trojans average 5.9 yards per carry; USC running backs gained 180 yards and two touchdowns on 27 carries without a negative rushing attempt.
Offensive lineman Tobias Raymond has started at every offensive-line position except right guard.

defensive_personnel.fact: Safety Prophet Brown intercepted a pass at USC's 1-yard line and returned it 99 yards for the decisive touchdown against Rutgers.
Safety Christian Pierce recorded a game-high 11 tackles, one interception and two pass breakups against Rutgers; USC scored two plays after his first-quarter interception.
Linebacker Deven Bryant had eight tackles against Rutgers and led USC with 20 tackles through four games.
Linebacker Desman Stephens II recorded seven tackles, a pass breakup and half a sack against Rutgers.
Defensive end Kameryn Crawford had six tackles and shared USC's only sack against Rutgers with Stephens.

injury_availability.fact: Safety Prophet Brown missed the entire 2025 season because of a season-ending injury suffered during fall camp and had returned to play in 2026.
Kicker Caden Chittenden missed the entire 2025 season because of a season-ending fall-camp injury and handled USC's place-kicking duties against Rutgers.
Wide receiver Tanook Hines returned from injury against Fresno State and caught an eight-yard touchdown on his first reception of the season.

offensive_context.fact: USC averaged 43.0 points and 500.3 total yards per game through four games, including 324.8 passing yards and 175.5 rushing yards per game.
USC averaged 7.2 yards per play through four games.
USC converted 30 of 46 third downs, a 65% rate, through four games.
USC scored on 19 of 24 red-zone possessions through four games, with 17 touchdowns.
USC led at halftime in each of its first four games and outscored opponents 106-24 in the first half.

defensive_context.fact: USC allowed 317.5 total yards per game through four games, including 203.8 passing yards and 113.8 rushing yards per game.
USC allowed 22.8 points per game and 5.7 yards per play through four games.
USC recorded eight sacks and three interceptions through four games.
Opponents converted 16 of 42 third downs against USC, a 38% rate, through four games.
USC allowed only 24 first-half points through four games, an average of six per game.

special_teams.fact: In his first game handling USC's place-kicking duties, Caden Chittenden made field goals from 35 and 32 yards and converted all four PAT attempts against Rutgers.
Chittenden was perfect through four games, converting all 22 PAT attempts and both field-goal attempts.
Punter Lachlan Carrigan's only punt against Rutgers traveled 56 yards and was downed at the Rutgers 5-yard line.
USC punted exactly once in each of its first four games.
Freshman returner Trent Mosley scored on an 86-yard punt return against Louisiana.

series_context.fact: USC leads the series with Washington 51-32-4, excluding one vacated USC win.
Washington defeated USC 26-21 in Seattle in the teams' most recent meeting in 2024.

other_relevant.fact: USC was ranked No. 12 in both the AP and coaches polls after improving to 4-0.
USC's Oct. 3 home game against Washington is designated as Homecoming/Reunion Weekend.
